_comment: Simulated authority register (FIN-POL-003 §4). Every entry carries delegate, delegator, scope, start and end, because the policy makes all five mandatory and states that email alone is not sufficient. There is no field in which to record an email approval. The expired and revoked entries exist so that the invalid paths are exercised by fixtures and not only by unit tests.

DEL-2026-0044.scope: Accounts payable invoice approval, facilities and maintenance cost centres

DEL-2026-0031._comment: Expired. FIN-POL-003 §4: invalid even if an earlier invoice was approved under it.
DEL-2026-0031.scope: Accounts payable invoice approval, all cost centres
